final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT MIN(a.link_to_event COLLATE BINARY) AS min_link_to_event, e.status, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN event AS e ON CAST(e.event_id AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(a.link_to_event AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY e.status), status_sums AS (SELECT status, SUM(member_count) AS total_members FROM status_counts GROUP BY status), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(total_members) AS overall_total FROM status_sums) SELECT s.status, s.total_members, CAST(s.total_members AS REAL) / g.overall_total FROM status_sums AS s CROSS JOIN grand_total AS g WHERE g.overall_total IS NOT NULL
